name: registry_312_focused_pvc
postInstallScript:
set -euo pipefail
kubectl -n kurl rollout status deployment/registry --timeout=300s
REGISTRY_IP=$(kubectl -n kurl get service registry -o=jsonpath='{.spec.clusterIP}')
REGISTRY_AUTH=$(kubectl get secret registry-creds -o jsonpath='{.data.\.dockerconfigjson}' | base64 --decode | sed 's|.*"auth":"\([^"]*\)".*|\1|' | base64 -d)
EXPECTED_IMAGE="registry:3.1.2"
ACTUAL_IMAGE=$(kubectl -n kurl get deployment registry -o=jsonpath='{.spec.template.spec.containers[?(@.name=="registry")].image}')
test "$ACTUAL_IMAGE" = "$EXPECTED_IMAGE"
CODE=$(curl --silent --cacert /etc/kubernetes/pki/ca.crt -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' "https://$REGISTRY_IP/v2/")
test "$CODE" = 401
curl --fail --silent --show-error --cacert /etc/kubernetes/pki/ca.crt --user "$REGISTRY_AUTH" "https://$REGISTRY_IP/v2/"

ctr -n k8s.io images tag docker.io/library/registry:3.1.2 "$REGISTRY_IP/registry:pr6152"
ctr -n k8s.io images push --platform linux/amd64 --tlscacert /etc/kubernetes/pki/ca.crt --user "$REGISTRY_AUTH" "$REGISTRY_IP/registry:pr6152"
IMAGE_DIGEST=$(ctr -n k8s.io images ls | awk -v ref="$REGISTRY_IP/registry:pr6152" '$1 == ref {print $3}')
test -n "$IMAGE_DIGEST"
ctr -n k8s.io images ls | awk -v digest="$IMAGE_DIGEST" '$3 == digest {print $1}' | xargs ctr -n k8s.io images delete --sync
ctr -n k8s.io images pull --platform linux/amd64 --tlscacert /etc/kubernetes/pki/ca.crt --user "$REGISTRY_AUTH" "$REGISTRY_IP/registry:pr6152"
echo 'PASS: expected registry image, TLS, authentication, and amd64 push/pull'
